message: Double keigo: お伺い already humbles 聞く/行く; adding させていただく stacks a second humble form.
Double keigo: おっしゃる is already honorific; られ adds a second honorific.
Double keigo: ご覧になる is already honorific; られ adds a second honorific.
Double keigo: お越しになる is already honorific; られ adds a second honorific.

pattern: 了解(しました|です|いたしました)
message: 了解 sounds like you are approving their request; many people find it rude toward a professor or boss.
ご苦労様 is said by a superior to someone below them, not to a professor or boss.
Chat messages over 120 characters feel heavy; consider email or split the message.
